title: 生涯スポーツ演習(ソフトボール)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports(Softball)
courseType:
Humanities and Social Sciences Program
Liberal Arts and Sciences Courses
Lifelong Sports
educationalGoal: Through learning activities for futsal, students will: 1) Understand the pleasure derived from sports. 2) Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle. 3) Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through the learning of softball activities. Specifically, students will learn the following: 1. An understanding of softball (1) Game characteristics(2) Rules and equipment(3) Implementation 2. Learning fundamental softball skills (1) Catch a throw(2) Catching a ground ball(3) Pitching(4) Batting 3. Learning applied skills in a softball game (teamwork) (1) Teamwork among infielders(2) Teamwork between infielders and outfielders 4. Game implementation and learning of basic rules (referee practice) Classes will be held once per week (100 minutes). In practical classes, students should wear appropriate clothing such as sportswear, T-shirts, shorts, and outdoor shoes. Students should aim to attend all classes highly motivated to learn. Students should pay attention to their own health condition. Students need to participate while actively showing willingness to learn fundamental skills Students should be prepared with both indoor and outdoor shoes in the case of rainy weather. Students should stay hydrated by making sure to bring adequate sports drinks on hot days.
requiredKnowledge: Prepared to learn a sports activity and understand safety.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for futsal and use them in learning activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in learning activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime.(2) Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them fully in class activities.(3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle.(4) Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.(5) Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits.(6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime.(2) Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them roughly in class activities.(3)Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle.(4)Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities.(5)Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits.(6)Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.

lessons.content: Go over the course outline and precautions. Learn basic knowledge about softball. Learn fielding skills (e.g., throwing/ catching, pitching, batting).
lessons.operation: Explain how to proceed with class. Organize groups. Conducted in the gymnasium in the case of rainy weather.
lessons.assignments: Homework and Review: Write Report 1 and understand the basic rules of softball. Read handouts and learn about competition characteristics and rules. Make a lifestyle self-administration list.

lessons.content: Review: fielding, pitching, and batting skills. Batting practice, including base running, teamwork, and refereeing.
lessons.operation: Practice to be implemented by each group. Conducted in the gymnasium in the case of rainy weather.
lessons.assignments: Homework and Review: Submit Report 1 (follow the instructions of your teacher). Review how to play the game along with handouts. Make a lifestyle self-administration list.

lessons.content: Learn the rules and procedures of softball in a practice game.
lessons.operation: Practice game Conducted in the gymnasium in the case of rainy weather.
lessons.assignments: Analyze the results of individual games. Homework: Make a lifestyle self-administration list.

lessons.content: Learn the rules and procedures of softball in a practice game. Plan and implement practice and game strategies based on the results of previous games.
lessons.operation: League games Check attendance records and submission status. Conducted in the gymnasium in the case of rainy weather.
lessons.assignments: Game analysis Homework: Make a lifestyle self-administration list.

lessons.content: Learn the rules and procedures of softball in a practice game. Plan and implement practice and game strategies based on the results of previous games. Understand the rules of softball, how to play, and the game format. Based on the previous game content, play more practice games.
lessons.operation: League format Conducted in the gymnasium in the case of rainy weather.
lessons.assignments: Game analysis Homework: Write Report 2 and understand the basics of game planning and operation. Make a lifestyle self-administration list.
